Ernest Obeng began what must be his most significant indoor campaign on 12 January at the Cosford Games when he sprinted to a fine p.b. over 60m - 6.68 - just shaded by the eventual European Champion, Mike McFarlane but ahead of some useful domestic competition in Watson, Asquith and Sharp.

John, Elliott Bunney, Mike McFarlane and Linford Christie set a new UK record of 38.28 secs to finish 1/10 sec. behind the USSR. Things didn't go so well for John in the 100m, a late tackle by an aspiring Portugese rugby player meant he failed to get beyond the 1st round of the 100m.
